source.title: Armagh Guardian, 20 May 1955, p. 5 ("Not a Single Contest: County and Rural Councillors Unopposed") ("The Rural Council")
source.publisher: Armagh Guardian (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names from the OCR text of the page (clean apart from the noted spellings; not compared line by line with the image); returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (31 divisions), 1955: no contests; nominations received by J. A. Dawson, returning officer. Returned unopposed. John West: no party label printed in 1955. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Tynan, Armagh County Council, 5 June 1958, printed 'U.': Armagh Guardian, 23 May 1958, p. 4 ("Local Council Elections: No Contests for County Council")).
